node.title: E1 first-band cubic-Hermite variance route boundary
node.statement: For the fixed N=256, square-mass-16, profile-(3,4,0) cubic-Hermite majorant, the margin is affine in (V,M_3), strictly decreasing in M_3, and its boundary slope lies in (107,108). The exact threshold at V=50 is 13, while the optimistic margin at M_3=0 is negative for every even V in 2..48. Thus the fixed majorant decides no residual chamber whose maximum M_3 is nonnegative; this route cut decides no variance level and proves no collision exclusion.
